Universal Law project handoff | 25 October 2026

Read BRIEFING.pdf or BRIEFING.html first. BRIEFING.md is editable text.
The briefing explains what works, why it changed, benefits, mathematical
connections, evidence, planned work and source difficulties. Its final section
contains the precise remaining information request.

This is a distribution wrapper, not a new engine version or a GitHub merge.
packages/: original full v20 app, v21 scoped supplement, latest v24 router.
The v24 ZIP itself contains the original sealed v22 and v23 evidence ZIPs.
audit_evidence/: portable audit artifacts for v20 through v24.
verification_reports/: exact original reports; historical local paths in those
reports describe the original audit environment. Portable evidence is included.
V24_DASHBOARD_PREVIEW.png: the tested latest interface.
SOURCE_RECOVERY_UPDATE.json: latest bounded source check, without live Drive ids.
CONTENTS.json: release identities and layering.

Verify this outer package from its extracted directory:
  sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

Each inner ZIP has its own README, verifier, manifest and scope qualifications.
Extract the chosen inner ZIP separately; do not overlay or rewrite releases.
The briefing contains exact setup commands. The latest router is standard
library only and offline. Full application/native mathematics have the
platform qualifications documented in their releases.

104 original records and 108 prerequisites remain unchanged.
Zero complete formal Universal Law theorem certificates.
The original CL v5 archive and related historical inputs remain missing.

Send this ZIP as an attachment to the Universal Law project. Local ChatGPT
download links are not a newly published public hosting service.
